visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a street-level view of a storefront with a large sign reading '享點茶餐室'. A chalkboard menu stands on the sidewalk in front of parked scooters. The lighting is bright natural daylight, showing a clean, urban exterior. (2) A transition to a close-up shows several stacked bamboo steamers with thick white steam billowing out. The camera is at eye-level, focusing on the texture of the bamboo and the heat of the food. (3) A male server wearing blue disposable gloves carries a black tray and places various dim sum dishes onto a dark wooden table. The indoor lighting is warm and bright. (4) Hands are shown meticulously preparing yellow shumai, pressing a meat filling into the wrappers over a tray of raw ingredients. (5) A series of extreme close-ups showcase specific dishes: yellow shumai topped with orange roe, white pearl balls coated in glutinous rice, and translucent shrimp dumplings with small red vinegar tubes inserted into them. (6) A hand pulls apart a white steamed bun, revealing a thick, bright yellow custard filling that flows out smoothly. (7) A large white plate is presented containing chicken feet in sauce, steamed pork ribs, broccoli, and corn, served over a bed of white rice. (8) The camera captures the process of making rice noodle rolls (Cheung fun) on a metal steamer, followed by a close-up of them served with XO sauce and scallions. (9) A thick, golden-brown French toast topped with a melting square of butter is cut in half with a knife and fork, revealing a creamy peanut butter filling. (10) A final wide shot shows the entire table spread with over ten different dim sum dishes and drinks, followed by a blurred shot of the restaurant interior with customers and a shot of the outdoor sign.

(4) A metallic clink and paper rustle are audibly caught in the background as dishes are placed and a bun is opened. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote '享點茶餐室', a Hong Kong-style dim sum restaurant in Kaohsiung. It uses a high-energy narration and a fast-paced visual montage of steaming, appetizing dishes to highlight the variety and quality (citing a chef with 15 years of experience) of the food, ultimately encouraging viewers to visit the location.
